g.text: Bridge — primitives on one side, composition on the other
drawer to grow when a shape is added,
and the two hierarchies would stop
The same Circle: 1 call on MacOS, 16 here.
The call journal is not on the implementor.
Calls sits on the abstract drawer: it is how the
tests watch, not something a shape may ask for.
A primitive added for a test's benefit is the
first step towards an implementor that mirrors
